reden: Yes. The audit explicitly reports that SatelliteEmissionsController.setMetaERC20SpokeOrHub lacks access control (missing onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)), allowing anyone to call it. This is the same function, same missing modifier, same access-control flaw, and would be fixed by adding the onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) modifier—exact match to the described vulnerability.
